name: Boku to Kanojo to Kokoro no Kakera
original_name: 僕と彼女とココロの欠片
source:
Father gets an urgent work appointment leaving main character in charge of his imouto and niece.
He has a lover, but something misses in his heart. He starts to see strange dreams more and more frequent. As summer vacations draw close he hears in his dream "The day of the appointment is about to come ..."

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父亲因紧急工作离家，把妹妹和外甥女托付给主人公照顾。
主人公已经有恋人，心中却始终像缺少了什么。奇怪的梦开始愈发频繁地出现。暑假将近时，他在梦中听见一个声音：“约定之日即将到来……”

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
